name: optika-design2
description: Lokamed site build: bundles src/js into assets/js/bundle.js and src/css into assets/css/*.css

scripts.build: npm run build:js && npm run build:css
scripts.build:css: esbuild src/css/styles.css --bundle --minify --outfile=assets/css/styles.css && esbuild src/css/pages/*.css --bundle --minify --outbase=src/css/pages --outdir=assets/css && esbuild src/css/shared/*.css --bundle --minify --outbase=src/css/shared --outdir=assets/css
